messages:
elaine: Noticed a p99 decode tail +10% on host-proxy after kernel-selector flip. Canary reproduces. Suspect host-side parsing + small-frame streaming.
mohit: Repro locally. Flame shows parse_frame + tokenize_inline + lots of syscall:read.
ryan: Share perf top?
mohit: snippet:
```
  31.0% host-proxy  [.] parse_frame
  20.0% host-proxy  [.] tokenize_inline
  13.0% host-proxy  [.] syscall:read
   9.5% host-proxy  [.] memmove
   5.5% host-proxy  [.] kernel_selector::choose
```
elaine: kernel_selector picked matmul_v2_fallback for short seqs (seq~10-16) which does an extra memcopy for alignment.
sam: KV cache hitrate steady (~81%). Looks like ingress framing + smallwrite patterns (http2/gRPC) are the root cause.
perf-bot: ALERT host-proxy p99 +0.09s since 2026-03-21T22:40Z. Correlated with selector flag.
ryan: Quick mitigations to validate on canary:
- prefer matmul_v1 for seq < 32 in selector
- bump smallwrite batching timeout 3ms->6ms
- enable ingress writev coalesce to reduce syscalls
sam: quick experiment: writev coalesce reduced syscalls ~40% and sys CPU ~12% in a short run.
elaine: applying canary patch with selector priority flip + coalesce + timeout bump. Deployed 2026-03-22T09:12Z. Initial canary telemetry: p99 down ~6%, sys CPU down ~18%.
mohit: follow-ups: add selector unit tests for seq buckets, add perf harness for http2 smallwrites, run KV cache stress to check no regressions.
ryan: I'll shepherd the rollout if canary stays green for 24h.
elaine: thanks all — monitoring dashboard now. :thumbsup:
